passages.text:
[Accuracy of PHQ-2/PHQ-9 and GAD-2/GAD-7 screening questionnaires > Screening questionnaires used by MapleMind > Depression: PHQ-2 then PHQ-9]
- PHQ-2 scores range 0-6; PHQ-9 scores range 0-27. - An individual participant data meta-analysis (44 studies, 10,627 participants) found that PHQ-2 score of 2 or more followed by PHQ-9 score of 10 or more had sensitivity 0.82, specificity 0.87 and AUC 0.90, not significantly different in sensitivity from PHQ-9 alone (0.86). - This two-stage approach lets most people answer only 2 questions, which is why MapleMind uses it to cap follow-up questions. - PHQ-9 severity bands: 0-4 minimal, 5-9 mild, 10-14 moderate, 15-19 moderately severe, 20-27 severe. - PHQ-9 item 9 asks about thoughts of being better off dead or self-harm; any non-zero answer requires immediate safety follow-up regardless of total score.

Many Canadians who screen positive for depression or anxiety, or who want help with weight-related health, have no regular clinician to follow up with. Navigation must therefore include options that do not require a family doctor (for example 811 health lines, walk-in clinics, community mental health agencies and crisis lines).

passages.text:
[Evidence on the bidirectional association between obesity and depression > Obesity and depression are linked in both directions]
- A meta-review of systematic reviews found a statistically significant association between obesity and depression in all nine included meta-analyses, with odds ratios from 1.18 to 1.57 (BJPsych Open). - The association appears reciprocal and may be modified by age and sex. A 2010 meta-analysis of over 58,000 participants established a bidirectional association among adults aged 20 to 59; the association was not statistically significant under age 20 (as summarized by Friedman et al., Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2025). - Proposed mechanisms include HPA-axis (stress hormone) dysregulation, inflammation, weight stigma, body image, sleep and activity changes. - A 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis of Mendelian randomization studies (Obesity Reviews, doi:10.1111/obr.70156) reported evidence that general adiposity is causally associated with depression.

[CANMAT 2023 update on clinical guidelines for major depressive disorder in adults (summary) > CANMAT 2023 depression guideline - summary for navigation > Boundaries for an AI assistant]
- The assistant may explain that effective treatments exist and that a clinician can help choose among them. - The assistant must NOT recommend specific medications, doses, or changes to prescribed treatment. - Measurement-based care supports using validated questionnaires such as the PHQ-9 to track symptoms over time and share them with a clinician.

- Most provinces: dial 8-1-1 to talk to a registered nurse (tell me your province for the exact service).
- Community counselling: find your local Canadian Mental Health Association branch - https://cmha.ca/find-your-cmha/
